answer: Every claim climbs the river of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nectar re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a practical systems telemetry descriptions, crisp technical observations register, it stays short.
